metadata.title: Open WebUI v0.11.0 upstream sync
metadata.description: Integrate Open WebUI v0.11.0 into Airis with migration, regression, backup, rollout, and rollback verification.
objectives: Preserve Airis billing, authentication, deployment, and branding behavior.
Integrate the official v0.11.0 stable tag with minimal conflict-resolution overrides.
Validate migrations and application behavior before a backed-up production rollout.
assumptions: origin/airis_b2c at cd51aefb6 is the current integration and production baseline.
v0.11.0 at f9590b801 is the requested official stable target.
The user approved manual SDD JSON lifecycle operations because the local sdd CLI is unavailable.
